item.title: Calls For Establishment Of MidWest Sexual Assault Trauma Unit
item.description: It’s claimed survivors of sexual assault in Clare and across the MidWest have less supports available to them than the rest of the country. It comes amid calls for a sexual assault trauma unit to be established in the region, which would allow forensically collected evidence to be stored for up to a year.
